title: Vrienden van Amstel VIP 2024
shortDescription: Web shop and admin for the Vrienden van Amstel VIP arrangements 2024, covering front end and back end.
longDescription: The web shop is available here.

title: Seating tool and invitations
shortDescription: Used for the National Remembrance Day 2023 and The Bodyguard, among other events.
longDescription: The seating tool lets organisations place visitors on a floor plan. It was used at the National Remembrance Day, with guests including Prime Minister Rutte, the King and the Queen.

title: Infrared ticket-scanner app
shortDescription: Used at the Dutch Grand Prix in Zandvoort, Vrienden van Amstel in Ahoy, and Prinsjesdag, among other events.
longDescription: Ionic app for scanning QR codes. I also built the system that generates barcoded tickets and emails them out.

title: Microservice / middleware
shortDescription: A microservice that supplies outage data to ziggo.nl.
longDescription: On ziggo.nl people can see whether there is an outage at their home address. That check uses an external API connected through a Node.js middleware microservice. When that middleware had problems, I supported Ziggo by debugging it.

title: Internal profiles page
shortDescription: An internal profiles page for employees.
longDescription: To help colleagues get to know each other and to measure satisfaction, I built an AngularJS profiles page. Employees could fill in a monthly survey about how satisfied they were.

title: Welcome screen after ticket check-in
shortDescription: A welcome screen that greets a visitor live after their ticket is checked in.
longDescription: The welcome screen was used during the King Willem I prize-winners dinner, with Queen Máxima among the guests.

title: Time tracking
shortDescription: A time-tracking tool for hours and billability.
longDescription: Temporary Work Design is jointly responsible for the wind turbines on the North Sea, among other work. We built a time-tracking tool on top of the AFAS API so their hours and billability were visible.

title: Swipe & Shop app
shortDescription: Swipe & Shop is best described as Tinder for fashion.
longDescription: I was responsible for the app's back end: improving imports of large product feeds, and designing an algorithm that made people more likely to see products they would buy. That work involved Heroku, Docker and AWS S3.

title: Roster generator
shortDescription: Automatic generation of the doctors' roster.
longDescription: The roster used to be assembled by hand and took a long time to finish. We built a tool that generated it, taking monthly hours, leave and vacation days into account. I was responsible for the front end: showing the generated roster and editing it there. It was never put into day-to-day use, but it worked functionally.

title: Back office and dynamic registration
shortDescription: Managing registration pages, tickets and visitors for We-Invite.
